description: This file defines the Create feature for user registration in the application. It includes data records for user input, a command handler for creating a user, validation rules, and logic for checking existing users, hashing passwords, creating a new user entity, saving to the database, and generating a JWT token.

classes.name: Create
classes.description: Encapsulates the user creation functionality, including command data, validation, and handler logic.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Processes the create user command: validates the uniqueness of username and email, hashes the password, creates and saves the new user, and generates a JWT token.
